response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his resume shows minimal direct experience with the core requirements of this role: production AI/GenAI systems, cloud-platform AI architecture, RAG, vector databases, or multi-agent frameworks. Only his most recent 4-month role mentions AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-solution development required, making him a weak fit for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior-level software engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Recent exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling at current role
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions as required
No evidence of RAG architecture, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
No mention of major cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) AI system design experience despite general cloud/DevOps exposure

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and leadership background
